name: review-triage
description: Reads every new product review, tags its sentiment and topic, drafts a reply for you to approve, and alerts the team in Slack about 1 and 2 star reviews.

howItWorks.label: Does
howItWorks.text: Tags the review's sentiment and topic (quality, sizing, delivery, service, price)

howItWorks.label: Drafts
howItWorks.text: A reply in your brand voice, for reviews that deserve one

howItWorks.label: Escalates
howItWorks.text: 1 and 2 star reviews to your Slack channel with the order behind them

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: To approve the tags and the reply before they are saved

plugins.reason: Alerts the team about low-rated reviews
